scope: Adaptive repeated development on 4977 Okutama centers; external scenarios remain required

arms.b1_bounded_separate_center_only: separate auxiliary and bounded correction outputs; repeated center supervision
arms.b2_bounded_separate_all_frames: separate auxiliary and bounded correction outputs; all cached frame supervision
arms.b3_bounded_shared_all_frames: shared auxiliary/correction output under the same bound; all cached frames
arms.b4_unbounded_separate_all_frames: separate outputs with the same nominal scales but no tanh bound; all cached frames

inputs.anchor: frozen fold-specific ARFTR; training anchors replayed from nested M4/P6/A3 probabilities
inputs.auxiliary_features: existing valid short/long DINOv2 CLS frame cache

architecture.separate_outputs: three-class auxiliary classifier plus two-output zero-initialized factor correction
architecture.shared_output: zero-initialized auxiliary logits mapped to centered posture and motion scores
architecture.zero_fallback: zero correction copies ARFTR probabilities exactly

training.optimizer_step_matching: all arms use all-frame step count; center-only observations cycle
training.selection: none; bounds and stopping are fixed before outer fitting

stop_rules.all_frames_help_control_but_not_anchor: stop center-CLS integration and test actual temporal motion inputs
stop_rules.primary_passes: freeze this recipe before untouched-scenario evaluation
